papers.title_en: Explainable Recommendations at Scale: LLM Rationales for YouTube Music Artist Discovery
papers.authors: Xiao Liu, Yanwei Song, Srivaths Ranganathan, Yuan Chen, Zheyun Feng, Parker Steenburgh, Jochen Klingenhoefer, Nathan Lasche, Gergo Varady, Tim Steele
papers.evidence: 基于LLM的大规模推荐理由生成
papers.tldr: 音乐流媒体面临利用熟悉内容与推动新艺术家探索的权衡，用户虽想发现新歌却因不信任未知艺术家而犹豫。本文提出解耦式推荐架构，将LLM推理异步放到离线，预计算个性化未发现艺术家候选池及自然语言解释理由。大规模在线A/B实验显示，LLM推荐结合解释理由能降低信任门槛，在探索面和整体互动上带来统计显著提升。该工业案例证明可扩展且低延迟的可解释推荐可行。
papers.abstract_en: Modern music streaming platforms face a persistent tradeoff: exploiting familiar content versus driving the exploration of novel items. While users frequently desire discovery, they hesitate to select unknown artists over proven favorites. Providing transparent, natural language rationales that explain why an unexplored item is recommended lowers this barrier. However, while Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at this nuanced explainability, their real-time deployment is severely bottlenecked by prohibitive inference costs and computational overhead. In this paper, we present an industry case study of a decoupled recommendation architecture that successfully scales exploration without compromising latency. Our system isolates LLM inference asynchronously offline, pre-computing personalized candidate pools of undiscovered artists alongside tailored rationales. Large-scale online A/B experiments validate our design. We demonstrate that combining LLM-backed recommendations with these explanatory rationales significantly reduces the trust barrier for new content, yielding statistically significant improvements in both user exploration and overall engagement on the discovery surfaces.

papers.title_en: When LLM-Based User Profiling Adds Value in Production Streaming Recommendation
papers.authors: Milad Sabouri, Neeraj Sharma, Sardar Hamidian, Shaghayegh Agah
papers.evidence: 基于LLM用户画像的生产流式推荐
papers.tldr: 个性化推荐高度依赖用户历史行为表征。现有语义画像可分两类：聚合式方法将语义物品嵌入数值汇总，LLM方法则生成自然语言偏好摘要再经文本编码器编码；二者均可结合近期与历史行为的时间解耦。本文在真实生产数据上系统比较四种画像策略，按表征类型与时间处理因子交叉，并考察不同用户行为类型、准确率与超越准确率指标及时间窗口设置。结果阐明LLM画像何时值得其显著额外成本，为生产流式推荐提供选型依据。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized recommendation depends critically on how user representations are constructed from historical behavior. Two paradigms have emerged for constructing semantic user profiles in content-based recommendation. First, aggregate methods derive user representations as numerical aggregates of semantic item embeddings. Second, LLM-based methods generate natural-language summaries of user preferences and encode them through a text encoder. Each paradigm can be combined with temporal disentanglement of recent versus historical behavior. LLM-based profile generation is significantly more expensive than aggregate approaches, raising the question of when this additional cost is justified. We present a systematic comparison of four semantic user-profiling strategies, factorially crossed across representation type and temporal handling, evaluated on a real-world production dataset. The comparison reveals how these strategies differ across user behavior types, across both accuracy and beyond-accuracy dimensions of recommendation quality, and across the temporal-window setting that governs the disentanglement.

papers.title_en: Learned Cross-Task Relationships in Multi-Task Models
papers.authors: Victor Zhang, Yiping Yuan, Florian Raudies, Bosun Adeoti, Brian Y. C. Leung, Sanjay Surendranath Girija, Naijing Zhang
papers.evidence: 生产推荐系统中的多任务建模
papers.tldr: 多任务模型通常需同时预测多个目标，但任务间关系若建模不足，性能与信息利用会受限；完整联合分布建模又因组合爆炸难以落地。本文提出一种学习跨任务关系的框架，用定向成对关系近似任务标签联合分布，从而在可控复杂度下实现任务间迁移与信息提取。该方法在YouTube通知、首页与Watch Next等生产推荐场景验证，准确率和用户满意度指标均有提升。作者进一步给出工作流模板，为更广泛的多任务系统落地提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: We propose a framework that learns cross-task relationships in multi-task models by approximating the joint distribution of task labels through targeted pairwise relationships. This approach improves performance via transfer learning and enhances information extraction without the intractable complexity of modeling the full joint space. Although our framework applies to any multi-task system, we demonstrate its efficacy within YouTube's production recommendation systems. Experiments across the Notifications, Homepage, and Watch Next surfaces show improvements in both accuracy and user satisfaction metrics. Finally, we propose a workflow template to facilitate broader future implementation.
